title: Reindeer Olympics
description: Race reindeer with fly/rest cycles under two different scoring systems.
writeup:
## Approach

Each reindeer follows a fixed cycle: fly for some seconds, rest for some seconds, repeat. The distance at any time `t` can be computed directly using integer division — no need to simulate second by second.

## Part 1

For each reindeer, compute the distance at t=2503 using the formula: `full_cycles * fly_time * speed + min(remaining, fly_time) * speed`. Return the maximum.

## Part 2

Now the scoring changes: at each second, the reindeer in the lead (ties included) gets 1 point. This requires stepping through all 2503 seconds, but the distance calculation per second is O(1) so it's still fast. Return the highest point total.
